title: Transient 503 on native mailbox relay sends and reads: identify the home failure and missing diagnostic reason
outcome: It is established from code whether `termal mailbox read` and the MCP termal_read_mailbox take different paths for a relay mailbox on a satellite, and whether that explains the 503. Any confirmed defect is fixed, and otherwise the disposition and remaining unknown cause are recorded.
acceptance: Record the source comparison of CLI and MCP native relay reads and sends, including shared routing, request/receipt handling, and the exact signed-response boundary that produces the generic 5xx label; keep the actual causes of historical occurrences UNKNOWN unless correlated evidence identifies them.

For each authenticated native relay request that produces a 5xx response on its home, retain a bounded process-local diagnostic record, readable through the existing /api/diagnostics/mailbox-relay-wakes endpoint, containing UTC time, allowlisted operation, HTTP status, fixed stage or typed reason, and a validated request id (or a fixed unavailable marker). Keep at most the latest 64 records and expose the number evicted; state that restart clears this history. Store no message bodies, credentials, locators or private error prose. Cover existing admission, handler/deadline and post-handler authority branches without changing relay wire responses, uncertainty, ACK, retries, authentication or link authority.

Behaviour tests through the existing authenticated disposable relay fixture force a handler 5xx, read its real record through the existing diagnostics handler and correlate request id/operation/status while verifying unchanged response/client outcome. Controls prove successful and 4xx responses emit no 5xx record, secret-bearing error bodies do not enter diagnostics, and the 64-record bound/eviction count holds. Focused checks and a fresh Codex+Claude read-only review pair pass with no outstanding in-scope Medium or higher before READY to the integration owner; final exact-input full gate and landing follow the standing rule.

completion.summary: Shared CLI/MCP relay error path documented and bounded privacy-preserving receiving-host 5xx diagnostics delivered in dual-host gated Combo19 89427b15 on master/origin. Historical transient cause remains UNKNOWN. Self asserted; No acceptance evaluation exists.
